# Titolum

> Titolum coordinates a qualified network of titanium CNC machining suppliers in Baoji, China, and manages engineering review, dual-source quotation, quality inspection, export delivery and customer relationships. Parts are machined to your drawing within 3-axis / 4-axis scope; nothing is stocked and nothing is sold from a catalogue. No commercial terms are published on this site — every quotation is built per drawing and confirmed in writing.

## Capabilities

- [Titanium CNC Machining Services](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/titanium-cnc-machining-services/): The full service offer — 3/4-axis milling, tolerance and DFM review, batch supply, surface finishing, dual-source quotation, inspection and NDA handling.
- [Machining Capabilities](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/capabilities/): Materials, tolerance, finishing, batch sizes, lead times, inspection documents, and the explicit list of what is not machined.
- [Quality Documents](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/quality/): How inspection is carried out and which documents ship with an order.
- [How We Work](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/how-it-works/): The quotation and production workflow from drawing review to export delivery.

## Part Families

- [Flanges, Plates & Interfaces](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/parts/flanges-plates-interfaces/): Machined titanium flanges, plates and interface parts produced to drawing.
- [Mounting & Structural Components](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/parts/mounting-structural-components/): Titanium mounting brackets, adapter plates and structural parts made to drawing.
- [Blocks, Housings & Manifolds](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/parts/blocks-housings-manifolds/): Machined titanium blocks, sensor housings and manifold bodies.
- [Tooling, Fixtures & End Effectors](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/parts/tooling-fixtures-end-effectors/): Titanium locating blocks and robot mounting bases for tooling and automation.
- [Custom Mechanical Components](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/parts/custom-mechanical-components/): Remaining custom-machined titanium parts, each reviewed against its drawing.
- [All Parts](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/parts/): Index of every part family and product page.

## Materials

- [Titanium Grades for CNC Machining](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/materials/): Selection guide for Grade 2, Grade 5, Grade 7 and Grade 9 — mechanical properties, corrosion behaviour, machining notes and a side-by-side comparison matrix.
- [Grade 2](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/materials/grade-2/): Commercially pure titanium — the most formable grade, strong corrosion resistance in mildly aggressive media.
- [Grade 5 / Ti-6Al-4V](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/materials/grade-5-ti-6al-4v/): The default structural titanium alloy — high specific strength with good corrosion resistance.
- [Grade 7](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/materials/grade-7/): Ti-6Al-4V with niobium — the crevice-corrosion upgrade for reducing acid service.
- [Grade 9 / Ti-3Al-2.5V](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/materials/grade-9/): Cold-formable alpha-beta alloy for pressure and spring applications.

## Industries

- [Industry Applications](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/industries/): Which failure mode each service environment produces, and the grade and part family that answer it.
- [Chemical Processing](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/industries/chemical-processing/): Wetted flanges, manifold blocks, housings and covers for chemical process skids and pipework.
- [Electroplating Equipment](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/industries/electroplating/): Immersed racks, carriers, brackets and covers for plating lines and anodising baths.
- [Industrial Automation and Robotics](https://titaniumcncmachining.com/industries/industrial-automation/): Lightweight robot bases, gripper hardware, locating blocks and brackets for automation cells.
